3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I came to the Grand National Assembly of Sordland to deliver a speech regarding the new Constitution and ask for the support of the Assembly before the upcoming vote.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I walked quickly through the corridors, giving my greetings to people on my way towards the parliamentary hall.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: When I entered the hall, the Assembly was in complete chaos, with shouting and cursing between the parties. There was a heavy argument about a proposal made by an MP from NFP.

6.speaker: Player
6.text: "We both know that our Constitution is flawed."

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I took my seat inside the special area reserved for the ministers. Gloria was shouting from her seat at the centre of the hall as she hit the gavel three times, with each strike heavier than the one before.

9.speaker: Player
9.text: "We must finally rewrite the Constitution of Soll and break our chains of the past!"

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: Despite her efforts, the argument continued for a couple of minutes before everybody took back to their seats and finally went quiet.

11.speaker: Gloria Tory
11.text: "Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell you to do so, either take your seat or leave the hall; so we can proceed with the procedures of this Assembly and continue our duties."

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: He murmured something from his seat which was illegible from my position.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: Some MP's from the NFP side shouted back at her in protest.

14.speaker: Player
14.text: "We are not specifically cooperating with someone, but everyone. We ask that you also join us."

15.speaker: Gloria Tory
15.text: "Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if you allow me to continue..."

17.speaker: Gloria Tory
17.text: "We have the President here with us today. He has asked to give an important announcement."

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up from his seat and shouting towards the members of the PFJP.

19.speaker: Player
19.text: "I'm saddened to hear about your opposite stance."

20.speaker: Gloria Tory
20.text: "Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show respect to the procedures of this Assembly!"

25.speaker: Player
25.text: "Do not stand against change! Be a part of it, Mr. Ricter! We can do much more together."

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: I walked to the stand as loud clapping started in the USP's side.

33.speaker: Player
33.text: "Don't you dare stand against us! Otherwise, know that the PFJP is guaranteed to be history."

35.speaker: Player
35.text: "It is you, who shouldn't use the word 'democratic' when you want your way to succeed but disregard our opinion."

36.speaker: Player
36.text: "The Supreme Court holds too much power..."

37.speaker: Player
37.text: "Our election threshold has harmed our democracy more than anything..."

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "It is time to strengthen the executive to enact faster and more powerful reforms!"

43.speaker: Player
43.text: "...Therefore, we propose changes to the Constitution to prepare Sordland for a fast changing new world!"

44.speaker: Player
44.text: "We will break the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional changes."

45.speaker: Player
45.text: "I will break down the obstacles before me!"

46.speaker: Player
46.text: "We will rebalance the branches of government to ensure a more democratic process."

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.

52.speaker: Gloria Tory
52.text: "Mr. President, with all due respect, I believe Sordland already has a functioning Constitution."

55.speaker: Player
55.text: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."

56.speaker: Narrator
56.text: I took a breath and continued.

58.speaker: Player
58.text: "It is time to make a new Constitution together!"

59.speaker: Player
59.text: "I ask everyone to think clearly about our current situation. And join us for change."

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.

61.speaker: Player
61.text: "Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand your votes!"

63.speaker: Player
63.text: "I ask everyone to support us in the upcoming vote."

64.speaker: Player
64.text: "Be part of a new era for Sordland. Join us and vote for our proposal."

65.speaker: Player
65.text: "I will address all the problems of the past in my proposal!"

66.speaker: Player
66.text: "USP will change and lead Sordland into the future!"

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.

71.speaker: Player
71.text: "We will bring change regardless of your support."

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.

77.speaker: Gloria Tory
77.text: "Thank you for the speech, Mr. President."

79.speaker: Player
79.text: "I expect your support in the upcoming vote, Mr. Ricter."

81.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
81.text: "We will stand together with any attempt to protect and strengthen our established political culture and national values. Thank you."

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: MP's kept shouting and responding to each other, creating a loud mess where nothing was legible.

90.speaker: Player
90.text: "Our Constitution doesn't adequately define or respect the separation of powers..."

91.speaker: Gloria Tory
91.text: "Order! Order! This topic has finished. We are moving unto our next topic..."

92.speaker: Player
92.text: "We have always been overshadowed by the Old Guard..."

93.speaker: Frens Ricter
93.text: "I ask Mr. President to reevaluate his decision and not ignore the demands of our people! Otherwise you should never use the word 'democratic' again!"

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: I slowly left the hall. The shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.
94.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Speech_PromisedToTrySoll"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_TradeDeal"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_TradeDeal"] == true) == false)

95.speaker: Player
95.text: "I call everyone to stand by us to make historic changes to our Constitution and bring it to the standards of today's world!"

96.speaker: Frens Ricter
96.text: "As long as Mr. President continues to follow the footsteps of his party's founder, we will be doing our best to stop this proposal. We do not welcome this attempt to break our system further."

98.speaker: Narrator
98.text: I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.

99.speaker: Player
99.text: "I just wanted to thank everybody for their comments."

101.speaker: Frens Ricter
101.text: "However, our demands seemed to be ignored by the government. Even though we made the reform committee's work possible, it was us, who were pushed back from the process."

107.speaker: Frens Ricter
107.text: "I would like to thank Mr. President for his speech. We, the People's Freedom and Justice Party, stands in agreement with the need for a new Constitution."

109.speaker: Narrator
109.text: Just as I was about to continue speaking, Gloria Tory interrupted me.

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.

111.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
111.text: <shout>"You and PFJP are nothing but puppets of western interests!"</shout>

112.speaker: Narrator
112.text: I walked back to my seat as many MP's asked to speak. Frens Ricter was among them.

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: Suddenly Kesaro Kibener started yelling from his seat.

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: Kesaro went back to his seat but the chaos in the Assembly continued.

124.speaker: Player
124.text: "Tarquin Soll will answer for the crimes committed during his rule! We will make sure of that!"

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: Gloria gave him a stare. She looked annoyed.

129.speaker: Player
129.text: "We will be strengthening the presidential decrees."

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: Some applauses came from the NFP and USP seats. Most of the others started to make loud noises again.
133.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Speech_PromisedToTrySoll"] == true) == false)

134.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
134.text: "Let it be known that the NFP will do its best to aid with the draft of the new constitution, and to reach an agreement with the USP. If our concerns are listened to, NFP has the power to make this proposal pass."

135.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
135.text: <shout>"You must have lost your mind to claim you were the reason for the reform talks, Mr. Ricter!"</shout>

136.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
136.text: "The nationalist movement wants to thank Mr. Rayne for his priorities. The National Front Party will not stand in your way."

138.speaker: Narrator
138.text: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started applauding.
138.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Speech_PromisedToTrySoll"] == true) == false)

139.speaker: Gloria Tory
139.text: "Tarquin Soll and his efforts cannot be ignored. We must keep following the path he defined for Sordish people."

141.speaker: Player
141.text: "We are not here to destroy Sollism nor our cultural values."

142.speaker: Narrator
142.text: I slowly left the hall. The shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.
142.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Speech_PromisedToTrySoll"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_TradeDeal"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_TradeDeal"] == true) == false)

144.speaker: Gloria Tory
144.text: "I'm sure the Honorable Members of USP will see that the President is acting rash by allying with the opposition to destroy the culture of Sollism that established Sordland."

146.speaker: Gloria Tory
146.text: "That was the extent of my quick note. Thank you. The President has the floor."

148.speaker: Player
148.text: "That was disrespectful Mrs. Speaker. Please don't try to sabotage my speech."

153.speaker: Player
153.text: "Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs. Tory? USP is behind me."

157.speaker: Player
157.text: "I'll act as if that didn't happen."

160.speaker: Player
160.text: "Give me the power to make Sordland great again!"

167.speaker: Player
167.text: "There is a victory growing with every morning..."

168.speaker: Player
168.text: "There is my country, beyond my existence or nonexistence..."

169.speaker: Player
169.text: "There is a revolution, beyond our and their existence..."

170.speaker: Player
170.text: "There is God, beyond existence and nonexistence..."

171.speaker: Player
171.text: "There is the evil that tortures and tears me down..."

172.speaker: Player
172.text: "There are songs to be sung in affectation of our battles..."

173.speaker: Player
173.text: "There is a spring that blossoms out of the graves of our fallen..."

174.speaker: Player
174.text: "Do not doubt the One! There is a decision coming from the heavens..."

175.speaker: Player
175.text: "Fear not when the dark falls! There is an artist painting the sun."

176.speaker: Player
176.text: "Do not dare call it defeat! There is a fortress made from my ashes."

177.speaker: Player
177.text: "Beyond the next morning, there is a victory waiting to be won."

178.speaker: Player
178.text: "Rest assured, your concerns will be addressed."

179.speaker: Player
179.text: "We'd like to have cooperation between our parties."

181.speaker: Player
181.text: "Thank you for your support. We are looking forward to work with the NFP."

183.speaker: Player
183.text: "I expect your support, Mr. Kibener! We can do much more together."

252.speaker: Gloria Tory
252.text: "You've just promised to try Soll, Mr. President! You are talking about the founder of this party. He is the true founder of this republic."

253.speaker: Gloria Tory
253.text: "What crimes are you talking about? You owe everything you have to him. This is unacceptable!"

254.speaker: Narrator
254.text: Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.

261.speaker: Narrator
261.text: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started shouting at me.

262.speaker: Gloria Tory
262.text: "Your time is over. Please sit down, Mr. President."

266.speaker: Frens Ricter
266.text: "Despite Mr. President here claiming to serve justice by going against his party's founder, we know this to be some hogwash! Know that we will be doing our best to stop this proposal. We do not welcome this attempt to break our system further."
